facts.text: Sir Alfred, the undead knight with a great sword, lies incapacitated but not destroyed in the Barrow Mound and may again attack anyone who goes down to him.
facts.uncertain_reason: Play never says whether or when Sir Alfred can recover from being broken apart.

facts.text: Sir Alfred, who the goblins say killed all their friends in the Barrow Mound, may kill more Free Goblin Society members there if he rises again.
Brother Dirk regards Sir Alfred as holy. Why does Sir Alfred, an undead knight, roam the Barrow Mound?
